source_title: TED periodic indicative notice 70566-2018 'Construction of the EuroAsia Interconnector' (OJ S 32/2018, 15 Feb 2018), section II.1.4 and Lot 3: Israel-Cyprus 13 km onshore (2 km trench in Israel, 11 km trench in Cyprus) + 310 km offshore; four converter stations
locator: II.1.4 short description; Lot 3 II.2.4
notes: Route surveys (2016 and the 2024-26 programme) start 'south of Vasilikos' (fastforward.com.cy, undated; Cyprus Mail 2016); a secondary report names Agios Theodoros (unverified). The converter is at Kofinou (lease of 74,088 m2, 33 years). The 11 km Cyprus trench is consistent with a landfall near Vasilikos/Mari (about 12 km by road from Kofinou). For the GIS the route is drawn from Kofinou; the 6-12 km difference is immaterial to the contested share.
